'''Bratt''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Hero of Cartao" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Bratt participated in the [[attack on Cartao]], a conflict caused by a Separatist invasion of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cartao/Legends|Cartao]] to acquire [[Spaarti Creations]]' [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] plant. As the battle progressed, Commander Bratt boarded a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] and headed off to shut down a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]]. Shortly after, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jafer Torles]] captured some [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] Separatists and asked Commander [[Roshton]] what he should do with them, to which Roshton told Torles to take them to Commander Bratt.<ref name="Hero of Cartao" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bratt was mentioned in "Hero's Rise," the second of three parts of the "[[Hero of Cartao]]" short story written by [[Timothy Zahn]]. "Hero's Rise" was featured in the [[Star Wars Insider 69|sixty-ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Hero of Cartao" /> released in [[July]] of [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/06/news20030620.html|text=Clone War Details in ''Insider'' #69}}</ref>
